A.name: gt_provenance
A.details: 22 user-confirmed validation counts agree with historical records. New labels and semantic votes are disclosed same-family model-assisted annotations. Shadow-direction category fixed in report layer; raw locked grouping retained. First-caption input contains correct numeral on 6/22 quantity images.

B.name: score_normalization
B.details: Unit FP32 embeddings and double-precision dot products. No prediction-statistic metric denominator. Raw margins, counts and ties exported.

C.name: result_existence
C.details: All 2808 scores, 936 item rows, 96 summary rows, 96 bootstrap contrast rows, 1038 reciprocal rows and 12 derived CSV outputs recomputed consistently. 320 historical decisions preserved. 376 text keys matched native final decodes and target texts.

D.name: dead_code
D.details: Metric functions are called by analysis pipeline and values appear in result files. All six score settings DONE; priors, scoring and replay have exit 0. Initial failure is retained. Static case-display labels checked against actual scores.

E.name: scope
E.details: One UCM validation split, 19 scene classes, one deterministic frozen run per setting. Caption input, differing training histories, assistant labels and 64-token budget qualify claims. Geographical independence and complete training/model-selection history remain unverified. Full GPU forwards and raw-image registration were not reexecuted by local auditor.

F.name: evaluation_type
F.details: Human-confirmed count references plus original-caption evidence and model-assisted visual/semantic proxy labels. Actual retrieval computation uses real frozen image/text embeddings, with no simulated environment. New image and text labels await independent human verification.
